firstPlayerRule: For a fresh game, choose the starting player randomly. If you just played Dominion and it was not a tie, the previous winner goes last; the player to their left starts.
clarifications: The rematch exception applies only after a game without a tie; otherwise use the ordinary random selection instruction.
Random selection for a fresh game is an official instruction, not a house rule.
